Amy borrowed a book about art from the zoo. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus terminal by bike. Amy usually has noodles for breakfast. A chain store took the corner unit.
The bus terminal is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like noodles and milk. Amy hopes to visit Paris one day. Best of all, the trial has a money-back guarantee.
Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Amy drinks milk after doing sports. Last Friday, Amy and David went to the bus terminal. Delivery is free for orders over fifty yuan.
Amy learned a lot about art. David is interested in swimming. Amy thinks art is interesting but a little difficult.
